purpose: Determine minimal sufficient scale for each dense embedding complementary view

citation_heritage_view.metric: AUC-ROC for cited precedent pair recovery
citation_heritage_view.stability_assessment: AUC stable 0.791-0.795 across all scales from 19k to 144k
citation_heritage_view.minimal_sufficient_scale: 130k decisions (21-year, 2000-2020) with sufficient citation pair density
citation_heritage_view.rationale: AUC > 0.75 threshold met consistently from 19k onward; 130k provides margin for pair density
citation_heritage_view.note: 144k checkpoint sufficient for validation; 174k adds marginal value for this view

cross_lingual_view.stability_assessment: Only 1K sample available; section extraction at 174k not computed
cross_lingual_view.rationale: Cross-lingual alignment requires full corpus coverage across all languages and legal areas; section-segmented embeddings need sachverhalt/erwaegungen/dispositiv for all 174k decisions
cross_lingual_view.blocker: Section extraction at 174k scale (corpus lane resumption required)

24_year_2000_2023.note: Not evaluated for hybrids; center_projected only

linear_hybrid_complement.stability_assessment: Hybrid JP stable 0.66-0.67 from 122k to 144k; consistently below TF-IDF baseline 0.73-0.79
linear_hybrid_complement.rationale: Adversarial gates PASS consistently from 122k onward; 144k provides confirmation
linear_hybrid_complement.note: 174k beneficial but not strictly required; 144k sufficient for validation

jurist_preference_scale_ceiling.analysis: True out-of-sample jurist preference ceiling for dense embeddings
jurist_preference_scale_ceiling.conclusion: Dense embeddings fundamentally cannot reach jurist preference target at ANY scale

recommendations.citation_heritage: Deploy at 144k (READY); 174k optional refresh when parquet 2022-2026 available
recommendations.cross_lingual: BLOCKED until section extraction at 174k; corpus lane resumption required
recommendations.linear_hybrid: Deploy at 144k (READY) marked exploratory; 174k optional refresh
